name: qa-test-reporting
description: Test reporting + coverage analytics: 10 skills covering JUnit XML and LCOV + Cobertura parsers, Allure, build-an-X reporters (coverage-diff, test-run-summary-author), the test-management-sync umbrella (TestRail / Xray / Zephyr Scale) plus Currents analytics, per-language coverage analyzers (JaCoCo, coverage.py; Jest/Vitest coverage lives in qa-unit-tests-js), a risk-weighted coverage targeter with a coverage debt ledger, and 2 agents (daily-test-suite-aggregator, release-quality-report-agent) for cross-suite roll-ups and release-quality reporting.
